product_metadata.title: Gama-Go Guitar Spatula, Blue
description: Serve up some pure Rock n' Roll deliciousness with the Flipper guitar spatula. Perfect for eggs, pancakes, or the Elvis special - fried peanut butter and banana sandwiches. The Flipper is 50-percent rock, 50-percent roll and 100-percent Silicone. It's dishwasher safe and tested up to 500-Degree. Crank up the heat, crank up the jams, and get cookin'.
